verdict.rationale: Green & Spiegel documents a dedicated business-immigration practice that processes visas for key employees, helps with long-term immigration policy and document maintenance, and partners with businesses on USCIS and Department of Labor compliance and investigations. However, the evidence never names the specific employer-side services in the story. Missing for 10: explicit H-1B registration/lottery and transfer services, LCA preparation and compliance, a described employer paperwork workflow (e.g., PAF maintenance), and independent corroboration.
